thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident fired -> Incident 2026-03-14T06:07:14Z for customer-acme (private-control-plane) : page to oncall
pagerduty: Paging @maya (oncall) and @lee (network) — priority: high. Symptoms: agent heartbeat lost, >3 failed TLS handshakes, 503s seen from dedicated gateway.
maya: Acked. I'm on it. Can someone post the agent logs and recent deploys?
eng-support: Customer (Acme) DM: "We're seeing 503 on inference calls since ~05:58 UTC. No changes on our side." They say on-prem agent shows 'green' locally.
ops-bot: Auto-note: last config rollout to acme-private was 2026-03-14T04:50Z (bridge-config v2.3.1). No autoscaler activity.
maya: Pulling logs now.
maya: (logs)
```
-- journalctl -u redwood-agent -n 200 --no-pager --no-hostname
Mar 14 05:58:02 redwood-agent[2371]: Heartbeat failed: tls: handshake failure
Mar 14 05:58:02 redwood-agent[2371]: Reconnecting to control-plane.redwood.internal:443
Mar 14 05:58:03 redwood-agent[2371]: Connection attempt 1 failed: dial tcp 10.12.8.23:443: i/o timeout
Mar 14 05:58:12 redwood-agent[2371]: Connection attempt 2 failed: tls: received unexpected certificate
``` 
maya: Looks like TLS mismatch + potential route issue.
lee: I'm seeing BGP flap logs on the peering: peer x.x.x.x -> y.y.y.y flapped around 05:57-05:59 UTC. Routing changed to backup path, which has MTU 1400 and we saw TLS fragmentation. Investigating with cloud provider.
maya: Quick mitigation plan: 1) Restart agent to re-establish session to fallback endpoint. 2) If TLS cert mismatch persists, temporarily route control-plane via our fallback proxy in us-east-1. 3) Notify customer of degraded service and potential rolling restarts.
tom: I'll prepare the restart command and coordinate with acme.
eng-support: Customer slack says they're okay with maintenance window now. They confirmed keys unchanged.
maya: Running remote restart: `ssh acme-gw 'sudo systemctl restart redwood-agent'` — output: "Stopping redwood-agent... Starting redwood-agent... failed (code=exited, status=1/FAILURE)"
maya: Pulling full syslog.
maya: (syslog excerpt)
```
Mar 14 05:59:20 kernel: device eth0: changed MTU to 1500
Mar 14 05:59:21 redwood-agent[2371]: tls: handshake failure: remote error: tls: bad record MAC
Mar 14 05:59:22 redwood-agent[2371]: startup failed: cannot bind to 0.0.0.0:8443 (address already in use)
```
maya: Agent is crashing on startup due to port clash. Possibly leftover process from earlier connection.
lee: I can probe ports from our control-plane: `nc -vz 10.12.8.23 8443` -> timed out earlier. Now shows open but TLS returns cert CN mismatch.
tom: I'm asking Acme to run `sudo lsof -i :8443` and confirm process.
eng-support: Acme reports `haproxy` was bound to 8443 after their recent HA config change. They put a proxy in front of agent; TLS passthrough misconfigured.
maya: Ok that's the root cause. Steps: 1) Ask Acme to move haproxy to 9443 or enable proxy-protocol passthrough for agent port. 2) We'll deploy a control-plane fallback to accept cert presented by haproxy (short-term). 3) Restart agent after port freed.
lee: Network note: peering still flapping but not required if we can get stable tunnel via fallback.
maya: Sending patch to fallback proxy now (rolling certificate acceptance for acme-sni). ETA 10 minutes.
pagerduty: Incident escalated to SRE-lead (tom) due to >30m unmet SLO.
tom: I'm on rotation to take lead. Handoff: @maya -> @tom at 06:00 UTC. I'll own comms with customer.
ops-bot: Temporary mitigation applied: route-control-plane -> fallback-proxy-us-east-1 (applied at 06:09 UTC)
maya: Fallback accepted connection from agent. Agent heartbeat restored at 06:11 UTC.
eng-support: Customer confirms 200 responses for inference calls at 06:13 UTC. They saw a ~4m backlog but no data loss.
lee: I'll keep monitoring BGP; opened ticket with cloud provider for peering stability.
maya: Root cause summary (preliminary): customer HA change bound haproxy to agent port (8443) causing binding conflict and TLS passthrough misconfig. Simultaneous BGP flaps caused degraded network path and TLS fragmentation leading to handshake failures.
eng-support: Impact: customer Acme (private deployment) experienced 15m total outage for inference calls between ~05:58-06:13 UTC, degraded performance during failover window. No data exfiltration.
maya: Postmortem owners: SRE (lee), Agent runtime (maya), Customer Support (tom). I'll draft initial postmortem and ETA for postmortem doc 2026-03-15.
tom: Noted. Closing steps: confirm fix with customer, schedule config check with Acme to avoid port conflicts, region-wide check for other customers with HA changes.
pagerduty: Incident acknowledged and resolved at 06:20 UTC by @tom :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Incident 12345 state -> RESOLVED. auto-close in 24h if no regression.
maya: Thanks all. Leaving notes in incident tracker.
